context.purpose: define the per-pixel confidence model, its bounded sufficient statistics, and the numeric types for every v2 accumulation; all buffers feed gate 5
context.selected_estimator: reservoir_sigma_clip (gate 3): confidence statistics accumulate over the clip-accepted set, so they are computed inside the clip call, not as a post pass

sigma_noise_f.meaning: per-frame noise sigma in normalized source units (post-calibration ADU/e units)
sigma_noise_f.source: frame-quality/provider stream analogous to the existing FrameQualityProvider; a per-frame scalar plan field is defined but the schema extension is delegated to gate 7 (artifact/resume gate)
sigma_noise_f.fallback: not finite or not provided => confidence falls back to the n_eff formula, never loses support

gradient.meaning: per-source-pixel gradient (gx, gy) of the normalized source frame
gradient.computation: central differences (x[s+1]-x[s-1])/2 per axis, edge-clamped, computed on the normalized source frame BEFORE any clip decision so the estimator is non-circular
gradient.usage: sigma_reg term gx^2+gy^2 scaled by sigma_reg^2

sigma_reg_f.meaning: per-frame 1-sigma registration position uncertainty in source pixels, isotropic
sigma_reg_f.source: provider/plan field registration_sigma_px; derived upstream from inlier residual RMS; model_predicted frames scale it by 1/model_prediction_factor? NO - fixed contract: the upstream provider already folds prediction into the delivered sigma; the estimator consumes it verbatim

sigma_sampling.meaning: deterministic sampling variance of the square pixfrac droplet under a locally linear scene
sigma_sampling.formula: sigma_sampling^2 = half^2 / 3 per candidate (uniform droplet of half-width 'half' has variance (2*half)^2/12 per axis)
sigma_sampling.inputs: pixfrac half-width only; constant per frame geometry

inputs.sigma2_model: sigma2_f,px = sigma_noise_f^2 + (gx^2 + gy^2) * sigma_reg_f^2 + sigma_sampling^2; every input finite >= 0 else the candidate contributes sigma2 = 0 and increments conf_degraded_count

over_estimator_effective_set.B_c: sum of accepted candidate weights b
over_estimator_effective_set.note: all O(1) per pixel/channel, accumulated inside the estimator's effective set (reservoir: clip-accepted members; uniform/winsorized/median: all valid; trimmed: surviving groups' frames)

formulas.sigma_est2: C_c / B_c^2  (variance of the weighted mean under independence)
formulas.confidence: S_c^2 / (S_c^2 + C_c)  in (0,1]; identical to n_eff/(n_eff+1) when all sigma equal
formulas.fallback: C_c == 0 (no sigma information) => confidence = n_eff/(n_eff+1) with state fallback_n_eff; B_c == 0 => no confidence, state no_source_support

sufficient_statistics.support_contract: confidence is a diagnostic scalar; it can never delete or modify support

operations.note: already fp64 in the selected dense scatter; not re-opened
gate-2 contract is fp64, not re-opened

measured_sequences.desc: large positive then corrective small terms

numerics_matrix.error_metric: relative error vs fp64 oracle for C_c and confidence

thresholds.support_invariant: confidence path can never change b/value/support
thresholds.selection_rule: cheapest accumulator meeting 1e-12 rel error across all sequences is selected; if plain fp32 fails and compensated fp32 meets it, compensated fp32 is selected; fp64 is the fallback and current default

fallback_state_machine.degraded: per-candidate nonfinite/negative sigma2 inputs are replaced by 0 and counted in conf_degraded_count

deliverables: sigma2_model and confidence accumulation implemented in the gate-3 oracle/reservoir path
fp32/compensated-fp32/fp64 measurement harness over the five sequences
adversarial tests: missing sigma, nonfinite sigma, single frame, thin support, zero support
results JSONL + decision JSON with tolerances and numeric-type table
gate-5 buffer inputs: confidence accumulators are 3 extra doubles per pixel/channel (B_c, S_c, C_c) plus degraded counter
